instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Role Switcher must be easily accessible in the header to simulate the 4 distinct user workflows (Sales, Operations, Finance, Admin).
2. On Mobile viewport (< 768px), prioritize the Operations Onboarding Checklist and Field Photo/GTP Upload experience with big tap targets and simulated GPS coordinates.
3. On Desktop viewport, display high-density ERP views: multi-column asset filter tables, 28-day GTP cycle calendar matrices, and Finance invoice approval desks.
4. Interest Queue must visually distinguish urgency: Normal (> 2 days IST remaining), Warning (<= 2 days), Urgent (<= 1 day) using dynamic countdown timers.
5. Use Sonner toasts (@/components/ui/sonner.jsx) for state feedback on task approvals, uploads, and invoice status updates.
6. Ensure all buttons, forms, and status badges include valid data-testid attributes for Playwright verification.
